te: Urgent meeting: framework for a holistic study on resolving the unrest in the southern border provinces, and follow-up on the subcommittees' work
se: Meeting (called as an urgent matter) on Tuesday 24 November 2026 at 14.30, Meeting Room 301, floor 3 (Senate side), Parliament House, according to the meeting notice. The main item is the framework for studying how to resolve the unrest in the southern border provinces, so as to raise the quality of development in every dimension holistically. The meeting also follows up on the work of the subcommittees, the report on the study visit to Songkhla and Pattani (30–31 Oct 2026), the draft report on the committee's work for fiscal year 2026, and the appointment of additional honorary advisers for fiscal year 2027
it: Framework for studying how to resolve the unrest in the southern border provinces, to raise the quality of development in every dimension holistically
Follow-up, progress reports and requests for approval from all 3 subcommittees
Report of the study visit on recovery and relief in the southern border provinces (Songkhla and Pattani, 30–31 October 2026)
Draft report on the committee's work, fiscal year 2026
Appointment of additional honorary advisers to the committee for fiscal year 2027

te: Hearing from the Thep Satri Task Force and the Chanthaburi and Trat Border Defence Command on boundaries and security along the border
se: Meeting on Wednesday 25 November 2026 at 09.00, Committee Meeting Room CA 327, floor 3, Parliament House. Agenda: problems and ways to resolve boundary issues and the security situation along Thailand's borders with neighbouring countries, with the Commander of the Thep Satri Task Force and the Commander of the Chanthaburi and Trat Border Defence Command, or their representatives, invited (The Senate has not yet published a summary of this meeting, so this text is the agenda from the meeting notice, not the meeting's resolutions)
it: Problems and solutions concerning boundaries and the security situation along the border

te: Following up the subcommittees, and considering a complaint about the halal food certification system
se: Meeting on Wednesday 25 November 2026 at 14.00, Committee Meeting Room CA 330, Floor 3, Parliament House, according to the meeting notice: the agenda is the progress of the subcommittees and working groups, and a complaint asking for a review of Thailand's halal food certification system and for an alternative certification system under state oversight, considering the scope of authority under the Islamic Organization Administration Act B.E. 2540, the Agricultural Standards Act B.E. 2551 and the Trademark Act B.E. 2534. A summary will be added after the Senate publishes it.
it: Progress of the subcommittees and working groups

Complaint: a request to review Thailand's halal food certification system and to develop an alternative certification system under state oversight (considering the scope of authority under the relevant laws)

te: Considering 2 study reports: ethnic groups, and low birth rates

te: Draft study report, the Elderly Fund, and homeless people and beggars
se: Joint meeting with the working group supporting work for disadvantaged people on Wednesday 25 November 2026 at 10.00 hrs, Meeting Room 302, floor 3, Parliament House. The agenda is to consider the subcommittee's draft study report, a senator's motion on reforming the management and finances of the Elderly Fund, and work on homeless people and beggars, with representatives of the Department of Social Development and Welfare, the Social Development Department of the Bangkok Metropolitan Administration, the Thai Health Promotion Foundation and Pattaya City invited, as set out in the meeting notice. A summary will be added after the Senate publishes the meeting summary.

Work on homeless people and beggars

te: Small airlines, and ideas for investing in the Thai Canal new city project
se: Meeting on Wednesday 25 November 2026 at 14.00 in committee meeting room CB 411, 4th floor, Parliament House, according to the meeting notice. The agenda is a study of ways to promote small airlines to link the air transport network, and considering proposed ideas on investment models for the Thai Canal new city project, with representatives of the Senate Committee on Economy, Monetary Affairs and Finance invited. The summary will be added after the Senate publishes it.
it: Ways to promote small airlines to link the air transport network
Proposed ideas on investment models for the Thai Canal new city project (with the Senate Committee on Economy, Monetary Affairs and Finance)
